scenarios.ABRUPT_REGIME_BREAK: Useful relation becomes invalid after a structural break.
scenarios.CALIBRATION_STRESS: Ranking useful while calibration is intentionally difficult.
scenarios.GRADUAL_REGIME_DRIFT: Feature/outcome relation changes gradually through time.
scenarios.REDUNDANT_CORRELATED_FEATURES: Correlated features represent the same underlying signal.
scenarios.SPURIOUS_DEVELOPMENT_SIGNAL: Development-period signal disappears in final test.

specification.selection_rule: Prefer the least complex challenger with robust stable/cross-sectional value, acceptable null/spurious/regime behavior, and no severe validation-to-test collapse.
